question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the sentence.

He tried to __improve __the working conditions in his office.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"improve"** means to make something better or enhance its quality. (सुधारना)

 
 
• **Example: **She enrolled in a course to **improve** her English skills.
 
 
 
• **"Spoil"** means to damage or ruin something, making it worse or less enjoyable. (बिगाड़ना)
 
 
• **Example: **The rain could **spoil** our picnic plans.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'improve'** is **'spoil'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Spatter** (छींटें देना): To scatter or splash liquid or small particles.

 
 
• **Example:** The paint **spattered **all over the floor as she knocked over the can.
 
 
 
• **Sprinkle** (छिड़कना): To scatter small drops or particles of a substance over a surface.
 
 
• **Example: **She **sprinkled **some sugar on top of the cake.
 
 
 
• **Specify** (निर्दिष्ट करना): To state or identify clearly and definitely.
 
 
• **Example:** Please** specify **the time and place for the meeting.
